title: Move toward your better-performing protein range.
subtitle: Meal composition
rationale: Adjust protein only when your recorded meal or daily range supports better training, recovery, sleep, or steady work.

evidence.summary: Adequate protein distributed across meals supports training adaptation and recovery.

sources.label: Protein intake and distribution position stand

indications: Protein intake is inconsistent or concentrated in one meal.
Training volume is rising without matching protein support.
Recovery between sessions feels slower than the load justifies.
